shots.action: Starting from <Picture 1>, Teddy sits in the sled under the brown blanket and slowly tilts his head back to look up at the sky. His eyes open wide and his eyebrows lift as green light ripples across his face. He pulls his right mittened hand out from under the blanket and points straight up at the Northern Lights, then says his line with excitement while his gaze follows the moving lights from left to right. After the line his mouth closes into a big smile and he keeps pointing upward, shaking the pointing hand twice in delight.
